data.name: Ateef
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'athara' which means 'to console' or 'to please'. In Islamic history, Ateef is the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his comforting and consoling nature towards the Prophet and his companions.
